successCriteria.scenario: Native macOS pointer+click QA: expand the notch, click Select category, move the pointer from the parent notch into the category popover outside the old hover range, choose a category; PASS only if the parent remains expanded until selection and the chosen category label/color is applied.

successCriteria.scenario: Dismiss the category/settings option surface without leaving it active, then move the pointer outside every NativeScheduler window; PASS only if the interaction pin is released and the notch returns to its collapsed shell.
